raw_text: Full **type hints**. Prefer **pythonic** constructs. Follow **SOLID**; use composition, interfaces, dependency injection. Naming: descriptive `snake_case`, `PascalCase`, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`; avoid single-letter identifiers except tight math. Self-documenting; docstrings only public/non-obvious. Specific exceptions; never `except:` bare; actionable context. No wildcard imports; group imports; cohesive modules. Testable, pure where possible; no globals/singletons. tests: use `pytest`; keep the tests to a minimum; use parametrized tests when possible; do no add useless comments; the tests shall be self-explanatory. Use fixtures; shared fixtures in `conftest.py`; use `tmp_path` for file operations.
